verdict.rationale: Firebase's CLI (firebase-tools) is scriptable and confirmed to run headlessly without a key (firebase-probe-5), supporting deploy of security rules, functions, and auth import/export (firebase-gh-1, firebase-docs-8, firebase-docs-18). An official MCP server also lets an agent create/manage projects, auth users, and Firestore/SQL data programmatically, confirmed via a live JSON-RPC handshake (firebase-docs-20, firebase-probe-6), directly enabling agent-driven backend setup from scripts or AI tools.
